title: My Best Friend Countdown Ended 11 YEARS Ago
premise: Everyone's cuff counts down the days to their best friend, and mine hit zero eleven years ago on my first morning at a plant nursery, when the only other person there was Gus, the coworker I have fought with ever since.
twist: The cuffs count down to the day someone BECOMES your best friend, so Gus became mine on day one, and his own cuff reads one: it has spent eleven years counting down to the day I would become his, which is tomorrow.
world: A bright glass plant-nursery greenhouse with white frames, tables of green seedlings, red tomatoes, a slate koi tank, a little old radio on a crate and Gus's round table by the far door; broad cloth cuffs with blocky numerals on everyone's left forearm.
